verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party documentation of a training opt-out, data-usage policy, or privacy control that stops user data from being used to train AI models. Community reports about workspace or git uploads concern data collection, not a training-exclusion control. User-side sandboxing suggestions are workarounds and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
